### Fig. 4a
```{r fig4a, fig.width=7.2, fig.height=4.5, dpi=450}
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(ggplot2)

call_cols <- c(
  "call_Illumina",
  "call_ppmSeq_multiread",
  "call_ppmSeq_singleton_HC",
  "call_UDSeq_multiread",
  "call_UDSeq_singleton",
  "call_NanoSeq_multiread",
  "call_NanoSeq_singleton",
  "call_HiDEFseq_double_stranded",
  "call_HiDEFseq_single_stranded",
  "call_PTA_singleton"
)

exist_cols <- c(
  "is_existing_lower_ci_0001_ILLUMINA",
  "is_existing_lower_ci_0001_DUPLEX_PPMSEQ",
  "is_existing_lower_ci_0001_DUPLEX_UDSEQ",
  "is_existing_lower_ci_0001_DUPLEX_NANOSEQ",
  "is_existing_lower_ci_0001_DUPLEX_HIDEFSEQ",
  "existing_any_PTA1_16"
)

exist_cols_full <- c(
  "is_existing_lower_ci_0001_ILLUMINA",
  "is_existing_lower_ci_0001_DUPLEX_PPMSEQ",
  "is_existing_lower_ci_0001_DUPLEX_UDSEQ",
  "is_existing_lower_ci_0001_DUPLEX_NANOSEQ",
  "is_existing_lower_ci_0001_DUPLEX_HIDEFSEQ",
  "existing_any_PTA1_16"
)

get_self_exist_cols <- function(callset) {
  if (callset == "call_Illumina")
    return("is_existing_lower_ci_0001_ILLUMINA")

  if (callset %in% c("call_ppmSeq_multiread", "call_ppmSeq_singleton_HC"))
    return("is_existing_lower_ci_0001_DUPLEX_PPMSEQ")

  if (callset %in% c("call_UDSeq_multiread", "call_UDSeq_singleton"))
    return("is_existing_lower_ci_0001_DUPLEX_UDSEQ")

  if (callset %in% c("call_NanoSeq_multiread", "call_NanoSeq_singleton"))
    return("is_existing_lower_ci_0001_DUPLEX_NANOSEQ")

  if (callset %in% c("call_HiDEFseq_double_stranded", "call_HiDEFseq_single_stranded"))
    return("is_existing_lower_ci_0001_DUPLEX_HIDEFSEQ")

  if (callset == "call_PTA_singleton")
    return("existing_any_PTA1_16")

  character(0)
}

call_levels <- stringr::str_replace(call_cols, "^call_", "")

call_to_exist_prop <- lapply(call_cols, function(cc) {
  df_call <- filt %>%
    dplyr::filter(.data[[cc]] == 1)

  if (nrow(df_call) == 0)
    return(NULL)

  self_cols <- get_self_exist_cols(cc)
  other_exist_cols <- setdiff(exist_cols, self_cols)

  other_n <- rowSums(
    df_call[, other_exist_cols, drop = FALSE] == 1,
    na.rm = TRUE
  )

  tibble(
    callset = stringr::str_replace(cc, "^call_", ""),
    overlap_class = dplyr::case_when(
      other_n == 0 ~ "private",
      other_n == 1 ~ "overlap_1",
      other_n >= 2 ~ "overlap_ge_2"
    )
  )
}) %>%
  dplyr::bind_rows() %>%
  dplyr::count(callset, overlap_class, name = "n") %>%
  dplyr::group_by(callset) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(prop = n / sum(n)) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    callset = factor(callset, levels = rev(call_levels)),
    overlap_class = factor(
      overlap_class,
      levels = c("overlap_ge_2", "overlap_1", "private")
    )
  )

lab_df <- call_to_exist_prop %>%
  dplyr::mutate(overlap_class = as.character(overlap_class)) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(callset) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(
    match(overlap_class, c("private", "overlap_1", "overlap_ge_2")),
    .by_group = TRUE
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    y_center = cumsum(prop) - prop / 2,
    y_edge = cumsum(prop),
    y_line = y_edge + 0.020,
    y_label = y_edge + 0.035,
    label = ifelse(
      prop >= 0.042,
      scales::percent(prop, accuracy = 0.1),
      scales::percent(prop, accuracy = 0.01)
    ),
    hjust = ifelse(
      as.character(callset) == "PTA_singleton" &
        overlap_class == "overlap_ge_2",
      -1.5,
      0
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup()

ggplot(
  call_to_exist_prop,
  aes(x = callset, y = prop, fill = overlap_class)
) +
  geom_col(width = 0.75) +
  geom_text(
    data = lab_df %>% dplyr::filter(prop >= 0.042),
    aes(x = callset, y = y_center, label = label),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    size = 2.5,
    family = "Arial"
  ) +
  geom_segment(
    data = lab_df %>% dplyr::filter(prop < 0.042, prop > 0),
    aes(x = callset, xend = callset, y = y_edge, yend = y_line),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    linewidth = 0.3
  ) +
  geom_text(
    data = lab_df %>% dplyr::filter(prop < 0.042, prop > 0),
    aes(x = callset, y = y_label, label = label, hjust = hjust),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    size = 2.4,
    family = "Arial"
  ) +
  coord_flip(clip = "off") +
  scale_y_continuous(
    labels = scales::percent_format(accuracy = 1),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.10))
  ) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = normalize_seq_method) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = overlap_colours,
    breaks = c("overlap_ge_2", "overlap_1", "private"),
    labels = c("2+ other platforms", "1 other platform", "Private"),
    name = NULL
  ) +
  theme_classic() +
  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = "Proportion (%)",
    fill = NULL
  ) +
  theme_nbt(base_size = 7)
```

### Fig. 4b

```{r fig4b, fig.width=7.2, fig.height=3.8, dpi=450}
exist_cols <- exist_cols_full



support_cols <- setdiff(exist_cols,
          c("existing_any_PTA1_16_singleton",
            "existing_any_PTA1_16_multiple"))


filt2 <- filt %>%
  mutate(
    n_support = rowSums(
      dplyr::select(., dplyr::all_of(support_cols)) == 1,
      na.rm = TRUE
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(n_support >= 1, n_support <= 5) %>%
  mutate(n_support = factor(n_support, levels = 1:5)) #%>%
  #filter(n_support<5)

med_tbl <- filt2 %>%
  group_by(n_support) %>%
  summarize(med = median(ILLUMINA_MAF, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

ggplot(filt2, aes(x = n_support, y = ILLUMINA_MAF, fill = n_support)) +
  geom_violin(trim = TRUE, scale = "width", alpha = 0.5, color = NA) +
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.18, outlier.shape = NA, alpha = 0.95) +
  coord_flip() +
  theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
  theme(legend.position = "none") +
  labs(
    x = "# Platforms supporting variant",
    y = "Illumina MAF"
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = support_colours, drop = FALSE) +
   scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(0, 0.3),
    breaks = seq(0, 0.3, by = 0.05),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0.02, 0.18))
  ) +
  theme_nbt(base_size = 7)

stat_tbl <- filt2 %>%
  group_by(n_support) %>%
  summarize(
    mean_maf   = mean(ILLUMINA_MAF, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_maf = median(ILLUMINA_MAF, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
stat_tbl
```

### Fig. 4c

```{r fig4c, fig.width=12, fig.height=5.2, dpi=450}
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(UpSetR)

support_cols <- exist_cols_full


# ---- Build matrix for UpSetR (missing cols -> 0) ----
make_mat_strata <- function(df, cols) {
  out <- lapply(cols, function(x) {
    if (x %in% colnames(df)) as.integer(df[[x]] %in% 1) else rep(0L, nrow(df))
  })
  mat <- as.data.frame(out, check.names = FALSE)
  colnames(mat) <- cols
  rownames(mat) <- NULL
  mat
}

# ---- Exact BAM labels from support_cols ----
platform_label_map <- c(
  "is_existing_lower_ci_0001_ILLUMINA" = "Illumina",
  "is_existing_lower_ci_0001_DUPLEX_PPMSEQ" = "ppmSeq",
  "is_existing_lower_ci_0001_DUPLEX_UDSEQ" = "UDSeq",
  "is_existing_lower_ci_0001_DUPLEX_NANOSEQ" = "NanoSeq",
  "is_existing_lower_ci_0001_DUPLEX_HIDEFSEQ" = "HiDEF-seq",
  "existing_any_PTA1_16" = "PTA"
)

# ---- BAM evidence matrix ----

big_tsv <- filt

mat_bam <- make_mat_strata(big_tsv, support_cols)

# rename columns to exact platform labels
colnames(mat_bam) <- unname(platform_label_map[colnames(mat_bam)])

# enforce your order (if you want)
#bam_order <- c("ILLUMINA","PPMSEQ","UDSEQ","NANOSEQ","HIDEFSEQ")
#colnames(mat_bam) <- factor(colnames(mat_bam), levels = bam_order) %>% as.character()
#mat_bam <- mat_bam[, bam_order, drop = FALSE]
mat_bam_filt <- mat_bam %>%
  mutate(.k = rowSums(dplyr::select(., everything()) > 0)) %>%  # number of supporting platforms per row
  #filter(.k >= 2) %>%
  dplyr::select(-.k)

# ---- Plot ----
set_order <- names(sort(colSums(mat_bam_filt), decreasing = TRUE))

old_theme <- ggplot2::theme_set(ggplot2::theme_get() + theme_nbt(base_size = 7))

fig4c <- upset(
  mat_bam_filt,
  sets = set_order,
  nsets = ncol(mat_bam_filt),
  nintersects = 200,
  keep.order = TRUE,
  order.by = "freq",
  mainbar.y.label = "Intersection size",
  sets.x.label = "Set size",
  matrix.color = NBT_METHOD_BASE_COLOURS[["Reference"]],
  main.bar.color = NBT_METHOD_BASE_COLOURS[["Reference"]],
  sets.bar.color = NBT_METHOD_BASE_COLOURS[["Reference"]],
  text.scale = c(7/8.3, 1, 7/8.3, 1, 1, 1)
)

main_break_lower <- 22000
main_break_upper <- 58000
main_break_spacer <- 500

map_main_broken_axis <- function(value) {
  ifelse(
    value >= main_break_upper,
    main_break_lower + main_break_spacer + value - main_break_upper,
    value
  )
}

main_break_tick_raw <- c(0, 5000, 10000, 15000, 20000, 60000)
main_break_tick_display <- map_main_broken_axis(main_break_tick_raw)

main_bar_data <- UpSetR:::Counter(
  fig4c$New_data,
  length(fig4c$Set_names),
  fig4c$first.col,
  fig4c$Set_names,
  200,
  NBT_METHOD_BASE_COLOURS[["Reference"]],
  "freq",
  "degree",
  NULL,
  NULL,
  TRUE
)

if (any(
  main_bar_data$freq > main_break_lower &
    main_bar_data$freq < main_break_upper
)) {
  stop("Compressed Fig. 4c axis is invalid: an intersection lies inside the omitted range.")
}

main_high_values <- main_bar_data$freq[main_bar_data$freq >= main_break_upper]
if (length(main_high_values) != 1L || main_high_values[[1L]] != 61891) {
  stop("Compressed Fig. 4c axis expected 61,891 as its only high intersection.")
}

main_bar_data <- main_bar_data %>%
  dplyr::mutate(display_freq = map_main_broken_axis(freq))

main_bar_break_marks <- main_bar_data %>%
  dplyr::filter(freq >= main_break_upper) %>%
  dplyr::select(x) %>%
  tidyr::crossing(mark = c(1, 2)) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    x_start = x - 0.28,
    x_end = x + 0.28,
    y_start = ifelse(
      mark == 1,
      main_break_lower - 100,
      main_break_lower + main_break_spacer - 100
    ),
    y_end = y_start + 200
  )

main_axis_break_marks <- data.frame(
  x_start = c(0, 0.10),
  x_end = c(0.16, 0.26),
  y_start = c(
    main_break_lower - 100,
    main_break_lower + main_break_spacer - 100
  )
)
main_axis_break_marks$y_end <- main_axis_break_marks$y_start + 200

main_y_max <- max(main_bar_data$display_freq) * 1.1

main_bar_plot_broken <- ggplot2::ggplot(
  main_bar_data,
  ggplot2::aes(x = x, y = display_freq)
) +
  ggplot2::geom_col(
    width = 0.6,
    fill = NBT_METHOD_BASE_COLOURS[["Reference"]]
  ) +
  ggplot2::geom_vline(xintercept = 0, colour = "black") +
  ggplot2::geom_hline(yintercept = 0, colour = "black") +
  ggplot2::annotate(
    "rect",
    xmin = -Inf,
    xmax = Inf,
    ymin = main_break_lower,
    ymax = main_break_lower + main_break_spacer,
    fill = "white",
    colour = NA
  ) +
  ggplot2::geom_segment(
    data = main_axis_break_marks,
    ggplot2::aes(
      x = x_start,
      xend = x_end,
      y = y_start,
      yend = y_end
    ),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    colour = "black",
    linewidth = 0.35
  ) +
  ggplot2::geom_segment(
    data = main_bar_break_marks,
    ggplot2::aes(
      x = x_start,
      xend = x_end,
      y = y_start,
      yend = y_end
    ),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    colour = "white",
    linewidth = 0.35
  ) +
  ggplot2::geom_text(
    ggplot2::aes(label = freq),
    family = "Arial",
    size = 2.2,
    vjust = -1,
    angle = 0,
    colour = NBT_METHOD_BASE_COLOURS[["Reference"]]
  ) +
  ggplot2::scale_x_continuous(
    limits = c(0, nrow(main_bar_data) + 1),
    expand = c(0, 0),
    breaks = NULL
  ) +
  ggplot2::scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(0, main_y_max),
    breaks = main_break_tick_display,
    labels = scales::comma(main_break_tick_raw, accuracy = 1),
    expand = c(0, 0)
  ) +
  ggplot2::labs(x = NULL, y = "Intersection size", title = NULL) +
  ggplot2::coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +
  ggplot2::theme(
    text = ggplot2::element_text(family = "Arial", size = 7),
    panel.background = ggplot2::element_rect(fill = "white", colour = NA),
    panel.grid = ggplot2::element_blank(),
    panel.border = ggplot2::element_blank(),
    plot.margin = grid::unit(c(0.5, 0.5, 0.5, 0.5), "lines"),
    axis.title.y = ggplot2::element_text(
      family = "Arial",
      size = 7,
      vjust = -0.8
    ),
    axis.text.y = ggplot2::element_text(
      family = "Arial",
      size = 7,
      vjust = 0.3
    ),
    axis.text.x = ggplot2::element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.x = ggplot2::element_blank()
  )

fig4c$Main_bar <- ggplot2::ggplotGrob(main_bar_plot_broken)

size_break_lower <- 35000
size_break_upper <- 80000
size_break_spacer <- 1000

map_size_broken_axis <- function(value) {
  ifelse(
    value >= size_break_upper,
    size_break_lower + size_break_spacer + value - size_break_upper,
    value
  )
}

size_break_tick_raw <- c(0, 20000, 80000)
size_break_tick_display <- map_size_broken_axis(size_break_tick_raw)

size_data <- data.frame(
  set_index = seq_along(fig4c$Set_names),
  raw_size = as.numeric(colSums(
    fig4c$New_data[, fig4c$Set_names, drop = FALSE]
  ))
)

if (any(
  size_data$raw_size > size_break_lower &
    size_data$raw_size < size_break_upper
)) {
  stop("Compressed Fig. 4c set-size axis is invalid: a set lies inside the omitted range.")
}

size_high_values <- size_data$raw_size[size_data$raw_size >= size_break_upper]
if (length(size_high_values) != 1L || size_high_values[[1L]] != 83682) {
  stop("Compressed Fig. 4c set-size axis expected 83,682 as its only high set.")
}

size_data <- size_data %>%
  dplyr::mutate(display_size = map_size_broken_axis(raw_size))

size_bar_break_marks <- size_data %>%
  dplyr::filter(raw_size >= size_break_upper) %>%
  dplyr::select(set_index) %>%
  tidyr::crossing(mark = c(1, 2)) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    set_start = set_index - 0.18,
    set_end = set_index + 0.18,
    size_start = ifelse(
      mark == 1,
      size_break_lower - 200,
      size_break_lower + size_break_spacer - 200
    ),
    size_end = size_start + 400
  )

size_axis_break_marks <- data.frame(
  set_start = c(0.5, 0.58),
  set_end = c(0.62, 0.70),
  size_start = c(
    size_break_lower - 200,
    size_break_lower + size_break_spacer - 200
  )
)
size_axis_break_marks$size_end <- size_axis_break_marks$size_start + 400

size_axis_max <- max(size_data$display_size) * 1.1

size_plot_broken <- ggplot2::ggplot(
  size_data,
  ggplot2::aes(x = set_index, y = display_size)
) +
  ggplot2::geom_col(
    width = 0.4,
    fill = NBT_METHOD_BASE_COLOURS[["Reference"]],
    colour = NBT_METHOD_BASE_COLOURS[["Reference"]]
  ) +
  ggplot2::annotate(
    "rect",
    xmin = -Inf,
    xmax = Inf,
    ymin = size_break_lower,
    ymax = size_break_lower + size_break_spacer,
    fill = "white",
    colour = NA
  ) +
  ggplot2::geom_segment(
    data = size_axis_break_marks,
    ggplot2::aes(
      x = set_start,
      xend = set_end,
      y = size_start,
      yend = size_end
    ),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    colour = "black",
    linewidth = 0.35
  ) +
  ggplot2::geom_segment(
    data = size_bar_break_marks,
    ggplot2::aes(
      x = set_start,
      xend = set_end,
      y = size_start,
      yend = size_end
    ),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    colour = "white",
    linewidth = 0.35
  ) +
  ggplot2::scale_x_continuous(
    limits = c(0.5, nrow(size_data) + 0.5),
    breaks = NULL,
    expand = c(0, 0)
  ) +
  ggplot2::scale_y_reverse(
    limits = c(size_axis_max, 0),
    breaks = size_break_tick_display,
    labels = scales::comma(size_break_tick_raw, accuracy = 1),
    expand = c(0, 0)
  ) +
  ggplot2::labs(x = NULL, y = "Set size") +
  ggplot2::coord_flip(clip = "off") +
  ggplot2::theme(
    text = ggplot2::element_text(family = "Arial", size = 7),
    panel.background = ggplot2::element_rect(fill = "white", colour = NA),
    plot.margin = grid::unit(c(-0.11, 0.3, 0.5, 0.5), "lines"),
    axis.title.x = ggplot2::element_text(family = "Arial", size = 7),
    axis.text.x = ggplot2::element_text(
      family = "Arial",
      size = 7,
      vjust = 1,
      hjust = 0.5
    ),
    axis.line = ggplot2::element_line(colour = "gray0"),
    axis.line.y = ggplot2::element_blank(),
    axis.line.x = ggplot2::element_line(colour = "gray0", linewidth = 0.3),
    axis.text.y = ggplot2::element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.y = ggplot2::element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = ggplot2::element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major = ggplot2::element_blank()
  )

fig4c$Sizes <- ggplot2::ggplotGrob(size_plot_broken)

set_text_grobs_arial <- function(g) {
  if (inherits(g, "text")) {
    g$gp$fontfamily <- "Arial"
  }
  if (!is.null(g$children)) {
    for (i in seq_along(g$children)) {
      g$children[[i]] <- Recall(g$children[[i]])
    }
  }
  if (!is.null(g$grobs)) {
    for (i in seq_along(g$grobs)) {
      g$grobs[[i]] <- Recall(g$grobs[[i]])
    }
  }
  g
}

fig4c$Main_bar <- set_text_grobs_arial(fig4c$Main_bar)

fig4c$Matrix <- gtable::gtable_add_cols(
  fig4c$Matrix,
  grid::unit(2, "mm"),
  pos = 0
)
fig4c$Main_bar <- gtable::gtable_add_cols(
  fig4c$Main_bar,
  grid::unit(2, "mm"),
  pos = 0
)

ggplot2::theme_set(old_theme)
fig4c
```
